exposure: Presence of underlined complications during CS
outcome: Prevalence of bladder injuries during caesarean section
Risk factors associated with bladder injuries
cohort: 3600 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section
finding: Bladder injury prevalence during cesarean section was 1.1%, and significantly higher in cases with underlined complications and repeat cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Repeat cesarean sections were associated with a higher proportion of bladder injuries compared to primary cesarean sections.
